clue.text: Tall thin agent gets in Independent Liberal

indicators.note: the abbreviations get inside the word for an agent, so they sit within it

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
L is the abbreviation for Liberal, as in party labels

explanation.surface: A lanky secret agent infiltrates an Independent Liberal party.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone lanky and spidery-limbed is long and slender, like a spindle.

clue.text: Support America in disgrace

indicators.note: the clue places America inside the word for disgrace

parts.note: a stain is a mark of disgrace

explanation.surface: Backing a nation that has fallen into disrepute.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep something up or bear its weight is to hold it up, a synonym for supporting it.

clue.text: Not a planned performance which accompanies film?

definitions.text: Not a planned performance which accompanies film?

parts.words: Not a planned performance which accompanies film?
parts.note: reads as an impromptu show, but 'not planned' here means secondary or accompanying, the score written to back a film or play

explanation.definitionFit: Background scoring written to accompany a film or play is music that is secondary to the main action.

clue.text: Tribe's number one came first, raised a wild flower

parts.note: Dan was one of the twelve tribes of Israel

indicators.note: in a down entry, raised means these words are read from bottom to top

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
to have led is to have come first

explanation.surface: The leading figure of a tribe came top and grew a wild bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns NO + I + LED upward into DELION, which follows DAN.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellow-headed common weed of lawns is a familiar uncultivated bloom.

clue.text: From the south getting about in your old craft

indicators.note: in a down entry, coming from the south means the letters are read upward
the short word for about is placed inside the old word for your

parts.note: thy is the archaic form of your
CA (circa) is the abbreviation for about

explanation.surface: Coming up from the south in your trusty old boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts CA inside THY to make THCAY, and 'From the south' reads that upward.
explanation.definitionFit: A sailing pleasure boat is a kind of vessel, and craft is a general word for vessels.

clue.text: Something to eat for Spanish, cooked pike

parts.note: por is the Spanish word for 'for'

indicators.note: cooked means the letters of the fish are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: A Spanish-themed dish of cooked pike on the menu.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastry case filled with seasoned pig meat is a snack or food item.

clue.text: Hobby of Greek character in recent times

parts.note: phi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
lately means in recent times

explanation.surface: A pastime lately taken up by a Greek personality.
explanation.definitionFit: Stamp collecting is a classic pastime.

clue.text: Broadcasting one day in SA port

indicators.note: the clue puts one day inside the name of the port

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a South American port
a means one

explanation.surface: A single day of broadcasting in a South American port.
explanation.definitionFit: Sound transmission over the airwaves is a form of broadcasting.

clue.text: Right to be in correct groups? There's not one among them

parts.note: proper means correct or right
fractions are parts or groups split off from a whole

explanation.surface: A right to belong to the proper factions, yet nobody is in them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Right to be in' leads into the first piece; the definition works because these numbers are all less than one, so no 'one' is among them.
explanation.definitionFit: Fractions with numerator below denominator are each less than unity, so a whole number 1 is never among them.

clue.text: One stops holding you and me to be ultimate employer

indicators.note: the word for one who stops holds the pronoun within it

parts.note: an ender is one who stops or finishes something
us means you and me

explanation.surface: Someone who halts things takes us on and becomes the final boss.
explanation.definitionFit: The person finally using a product is its last user, playfully called its ultimate employer.

clue.text: Another boy Robin in dotage?

parts.note: second means another, as in a second helping
a child, such as a boy
Robin Hood is the legendary English outlaw

explanation.surface: Is a second son named Robin a sign of senility?
explanation.definitionFit: Old age when someone becomes childlike again is the stage of senility.

clue.text: Two days in the drink? That's rotten

indicators.note: the clue says the two days sit inside the drink

parts.note: ale is a drink, beer
D is the abbreviation for day, so two of them give DD

explanation.surface: Two days spent drinking leave someone feeling awful.
explanation.definitionFit: Addled eggs are spoiled, so the verb or adjective here means gone bad.

clue.text: Have to pay a pound to get in milk dispensers' driers

indicators.note: the debt and the pound get inside the word for milk dispensers

parts.note: teats dispense milk
to owe is to have to pay
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling

explanation.surface: Paying a pound to get into a dairy and its cloths.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get in' puts OWE and L inside TEATS.
explanation.definitionFit: Kitchen cloths for wiping washed dishes are used to dry them.

clue.text: iced

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'iced (3,6)', cut short: no wordplay or definition survives for NONFINITE, and a search found nothing.

clue.text: Poor saint I took in is never satisfied

indicators.note: poor signals that the letters of these words are in bad shape and rearranged

parts.note: ate means took in food

explanation.surface: A hungry saint who eats is still never full.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone insatiable can never be filled or contented.

clue.text: Wrongly imply one could be finer

indicators.note: could be signals the letters of the word may be rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: A remark about how one might be more refined.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is fair: using this verb to mean 'suggest' is a common error.
explanation.definitionFit: Many speakers misuse the verb for deduce in place of suggest, so it is a mistaken substitute.

clue.text: One doctor with a weapon shows lack of proportion

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
MB is the medical degree Bachelor of Medicine
a lance is a spear-like weapon

explanation.surface: A doctor armed with a spear seems unbalanced.
explanation.definitionFit: An unequal distribution is a want of balance.

clue.text: One in two will make a writer

indicators.note: the clue says one goes inside the word for two

parts.note: twins come in pairs of two
a means one

explanation.surface: A single one inside a pair produces an author.
explanation.walkthrough: The writer is Mark Twain; the answer also means 'two', which makes the surface neat.
explanation.definitionFit: Mark Twain was the American novelist of Tom Sawyer.

clue.text: Lit up about gen which is used for cooking

indicators.note: the reversed word goes around the word for information
in a down entry, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: Lighting up some information that is useful for cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns LIT into TIL, and 'about' puts INFO inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Thin aluminium sheet is used to wrap and roast food in an oven.

clue.text: Liberally season with bay a source of protein

indicators.note: liberally suggests a free treatment, signalling these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A cook's instruction to season generously with bay leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: These legumes are a widely used vegetable protein.

clue.text: Lieutenant's found in precipitous refuge

indicators.note: the officer is found inside the word for steep

parts.note: sheer means steep or precipitous
LT is the abbreviation for lieutenant

explanation.surface: An officer discovers a hideout on a steep cliff.
explanation.definitionFit: A place of protection from danger is a haven.

clue.text: Important address featuring singular book by cardinal?

parts.note: Numbers is a book of the Bible; singular makes it number
ten is a cardinal number

explanation.surface: A grand address featuring a book written by a churchman.
explanation.walkthrough: Number Ten Downing Street is the UK prime minister's residence; 'cardinal' means a cardinal number, not a churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: 10 Downing Street is the official residence of the British prime minister.

clue.text: Miscalculation of terrorists

indicators.note: of indicates the letters come from part of the next word

explanation.surface: A mistaken judgement made by terrorists.
explanation.definitionFit: A mistake in working out figures is a slip.

clue.text: Nymph in a crude bit of publicity

indicators.note: crude suggests rough, unrefined form, signalling the two words are rearranged

parts.note: an ad is a piece of advertising

explanation.surface: A nymph appears in a vulgar advertisement.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth a water spirit of springs and rivers is a nymph.

clue.text: "Turner is dead" hospital admitted

indicators.note: the hospital letter is admitted inside the word for dead

parts.note: late means dead, as in 'the late Mr X'

explanation.surface: A news report that the painter Turner has died in hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner' suggests the painter, but it is a machine that turns wood or metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that spins a workpiece to shape it turns things.

clue.text: Comment by Mail which keeps guns firing

parts.note: an observation is a comment
post is mail

explanation.surface: A newspaper comment piece on keeping weapons in action.
explanation.definitionFit: Spotters in a forward position direct artillery onto targets so fire continues.

clue.text: Fodder is capital for some of the Swiss

definitions.meaning: a type of alfalfa grown as animal feed

definitions.text: capital for some of the Swiss
definitions.meaning: the city that is capital of one Swiss canton

explanation.definitionFit: Alfalfa is a forage crop, and the Swiss city is the chief town of its canton.

clue.text: Reds upset by sermon of theatrical type

indicators.note: upset signals the word is knocked over and its letters rearranged

parts.note: SER is an abbreviation of sermon

explanation.surface: Communists upset by a preacher's address about actors.
explanation.definitionFit: A backstage assistant helps actors into costume in a theatre.
